API Request Description
This endpoint allows you to retrieve event data for a specific community within a tenant.

Request URL
POST {{client_api}}/reports/tenant/:tenantID/community/:communityID/events

Request Parameters

pSize (integer): The number of records to return per page. In the example, it is set to 10.

pIndex (integer): The page index for pagination. In the example, it is set to 1.

from (string): The start date and time for the events to be retrieved, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:S

Request Description
This API endpoint is used to submit metrics data for a specific community within a tenant. The purpose of this request is to track and analyze various metrics related to community activities.

Request Parameters
The request must include a JSON body with the following parameters:

metricsName (string): The name of the metric you want to report (e.g., "M_GT_SUCCESSFUL_AUTHENTICATION").

from (string): The start date and time for the metric data in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

Request Description
This API endpoint allows you to generate an application usage report for a specific tenant and community within the client application.

Request Method

POST

Request URL

{{client_api}}/reports/tenant/:tenantID/community/:communityID/application_usage_report

Request Body
The request body must be in JSON format and should contain the following parameters:

from (string): The start date and time for the report in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS.

to (string): The end date

Request Description
This is a POST request to retrieve the audit log for a specific community within a tenant.

Endpoint:

{{client_api}}/reports/tenant/:tenantID/community/:communityID/audit_log

Request Body:
The request body should be in JSON format and include the following parameters:

pSize (integer): The number of records to return per page.

pIndex (integer): The index of the page to retrieve.

from (string): The start date and time for the audit log in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.SSS

Request Description
This is a POST request to retrieve the last seen report for a specific user in a community.

Endpoint:

{{client_api}}/reports/tenant/:tenantID/community/:communityID/last_seen_report

Request Body:
The request requires a JSON payload with the following parameters:

user_id (string): The unique identifier for the user.

device_id (string): The unique identifier for the device used by the user.

eventName (string): The name of the event being reported (e.g., login success).
